input.synthetic: Must be true. All records must be fabricated; declaration is not identity verification.
input.sources: Array of unique {id,title,text}; max 100 sources, 10000 characters each
input.customers: Array of unique {id,name,iban,kyc_status,screening_flags?,card_number?}; IBAN must begin SYNTH-; KYC is verified/pending/rejected; flags pep/sanctions_match
input.transactions: Optional array of {id,customer_id,amount,currency,date}, or {format:csv,data:string}; exact header id,customer_id,amount,currency,date
input.loan_applications: Optional array of {id,customer_id,amount,annual_income,currency}; income uses same currency as loan
input.validation: One shared validator normalizes all formats; unique IDs per entity kind, valid foreign keys, positive finite amounts <= 1e12, nonnegative income, uppercase 3-letter currencies, valid YYYY-MM-DD dates. At most 1000 customers, combined transactions, and loans each. Unknown fields discarded rather than echoed.

output.citation_offsets: Zero-based Python Unicode character offsets, end exclusive, into returned unchanged source text

cross_stage_handoffs: CLI JSON -> shared validation/normalization -> one deterministic passage retrieval and extraction stage -> integrated entity assessments and JSON serialization

behavior.retrieval: Sentence-like spans split on .!? and newlines; lowercase ASCII token overlap excluding documented code stopwords. Positive matches only; relevance is distinct matched query terms. Sort descending overlap, then source ID and start offset. Extractive quotes only, no unsupported paraphrases.
behavior.screening: KYC not verified +40; sanctions_match +80; pep +20; USD transaction >=10000 +30; loans with zero income +50 otherwise amount >3x annual income +30. Customer flags propagate to transactions/loans. Scores capped at 100, all contributions explained. No automated approval/rejection.
behavior.masking: Structured card fields retain only last four digits. Free-text fields with 13..19 card-like digits are rejected to preserve exact citations without leaking PANs. Error messages are generic.
behavior.fixtures: Example is clearly synthetic. Tests generate 40 randomized transactions with random.Random(51), ensuring deterministic replay.
behavior.llm: No LLM step, injected callable, external knowledge source, or provider required

test_outcomes.cli_example_stdout: One valid JSON object with status ok
